story.title: Where the name comes from
story.p1: Ujtö̀ means “word” —and also “language”— in Bribri, the language of the Bribri people of Talamanca, Costa Rica.
story.p2: Bribri is a tonal language: the diaeresis marks a vowel of its own, and the grave accent a falling tone. That is why we write Ujtö̀ with all its marks.
story.p3: We chose it because that is what we do: turn the voice in a video into words you can read, keep and share. From video to word.
story.attribution: Inspired, with respect, by the Bribri language of Talamanca, Costa Rica.
story.source: Meaning per the Bribri–Spanish Dictionary of the Universidad de Costa Rica
